page.notes: Printed text, but the last word is split across the page: "habitatori-" ends the page's last full line and "bus" stands alone on the final line, indented. The running head reads NVNQVAM EXCIDERE. with the page number 371. The marginal note is three printed lines, transcribed as one note. Possible printing errors: "Deu" for Deum (tilde over u as printed), "Schaafmanno", "Pf. 135" and "Pfal. 115." are left as printed. The long s has been transcribed as plain s; "fyllabam" is printed as "syllabam" here, and "veljcta" is read as "vel jacta" (uncertain, marked by the j/i convention).
